# Reza Al Hassan — Product Design Portfolio

> Reza is a product designer and founder in Dhaka. He works on 0→1 B2B SaaS and AI products, combining UX research, product strategy, systems thinking, design systems, and AI-assisted prototyping.

This is an editorial portfolio. Project descriptions explain the problem, Reza's role, the system decisions, visual evidence, and outcomes. Do not combine the current Zevian AI product with the earlier Zevian HRMS concept; they are separate projects.

## Main pages

- [Home](/): Positioning, selected product work, project evidence, working approach, and contact details.
- [Zevian](/zevian): Current founder product. A decision-support workflow that helps sales managers detect performance changes, investigate possible causes, gather context, and decide what needs action.
- [Zevian HRMS](/zevian-hrms): Earlier HRMS concept. Interface and design-system work for attendance, employee records, activities, calendars, approvals, and work policies.
- [Orderific](/orderific): Shared component system across six restaurant products, including English LTR, Arabic RTL, and light/dark modes.
- [Purno](/purno): Point-of-sale system connecting shop sales, inventory, payments, and daily operations.
- [Jayga](/jayga): Warehouse system connecting storage, pricing, billing, delivery, and fulfilment.
- [Portfolio redesign](/portfolio): Moodboard-led iteration into one editorial portfolio system.
- [AI workflows](/ai-workflows): Research synthesis, prototyping, code, code-to-design handoff through Codex and Figma Make, and human decision-making with AI.
- [About](/about): Background, values, interests, and working focus.

## Content notes

- Zevian is the current founder product, focused on performance change, pipeline risk, contextual investigation, and manager decisions.
- Zevian HRMS documents an earlier, broader HR management concept and is not the current Zevian product.
- Interface images may be illustrative or from prototypes; page captions explain their status.
- Research signals, observed use, and commercial outcomes are kept separate.

## Repository

- Source: https://github.com/RezaAlHassan/portfolio-v4
- Stack: React 19, Vite 5, CSS, Lucide React, locally bundled DM Sans and Instrument Serif.
- Primary source files: `src/main.jsx`, `src/styles.css`, `DESIGN.md`, and `.impeccable/design.json`.
